title: Contrastive Bootstrap Representation Learning for Label-Efficient Agricultural Image Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.15610v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Expert annotation remains a major bottleneck in agricultural image classification, where collecting images is often easier than obtaining reliable labels from domain specialists. Self-supervised learning can reduce this dependence by pretraining transferable representations on unlabelled imagery. Contrastive and bootstrap methods provide two established but distinct training signals, motivating an empirical study of a formulation that applies both signals within one representation path under severe downstream label scarcity. We present Contrastive Bootstrap Representation Learning (CBRL), which jointly optimises SimCLR-style NT-Xent contrastive learning and bidirectional BYOL-style exponential-moving-average target prediction within a shared online projection space. Using a ViT-L/16 backbone and 10% of the downstream labels, we report single-seed point estimates on four primary agricultural test benchmarks plus an exploratory 33-image

translated_title: 面向标签高效农业图像分类的对比自举表示学习
translated_abstract: 专家标注仍然是农业图像分类中的主要瓶颈，因为收集图像往往比从领域专家那里获得可靠标签更容易。自监督学习可以通过在未标注图像上预训练可迁移的表示来减少这种依赖。对比学习和自举方法提供了两种成熟但截然不同的训练信号，这促使我们对一种形式化方法进行实证研究，即在下游标签极度稀缺的情况下，将两种信号应用于同一条表示路径中。我们提出了对比自举表示学习，它在共享的在线投影空间中联合优化SimCLR风格的NT-Xent对比学习和双向BYOL风格的指数移动平均目标预测。使用ViT-L/16骨干网络和10%的下游标签，我们在四个主要农业测试基准以及一个包含33张图像的探索性测试集上报告了单种子点估计结果。
tldr: 提出CBRL方法，在共享的在线投影空间中同时联合优化SimCLR式对比学习和双向BYOL式自举预测两种训练信号，仅需10%的下游标注数据即可实现高质量的农业图像分类表示学习。
en_tdlr: CBRL jointly optimizes SimCLR-style NT-Xent contrastive learning and bidirectional BYOL-style EMA target prediction within a shared online projection space, enabling label-efficient agricultural image classification with only 10% of downstream labels.
